title: Public-source document index
method: Manually checked selected passages against the official permit. Printed page numbers match one-based PDF page positions. Descriptions are navigation aids, not a complete permit summary or a determination of applicability.

entries.title: Find the supporting records
entries.summary: Locate the passage about supporting material kept with the stormwater plan, including correspondence, training and inspection records.
entries.question: Which referenced records are in the approved project packet? A source passage alone does not establish that a site holds them.

entries.title: Trace plan revisions
entries.summary: Locate the passage about reviewing the stormwater plan and dating its revisions.
entries.question: Which plan version is the team reviewing? No facility plan or revision history is included in this example.

entries.title: Locate the retention passage
entries.summary: Find the retention passage for monitoring and reporting records, application data and stormwater plan history. Read its conditions and exceptions in the source.
entries.question: Does another permit condition or agency direction change the retention decision? A qualified reviewer must check the full context.

entries.title: Find monitoring documentation
entries.summary: Locate the passage on documenting monitoring and inspection procedures in the stormwater plan.
entries.question: Which procedures and responsible people apply to this facility? This public permit does not identify the project team.

entries.title: Check the record detail passage
entries.summary: Locate the passage on retained records and monitoring record contents, including sampling details, analysis and quality-control records.
entries.question: What can the underlying project records substantiate? The index does not verify a sample, laboratory result or compliance conclusion.
